local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 24)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)

border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)

label.Text = "RCC / grafito / rebote"

label.TextSize = 18

  active = not active

  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 42)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22

if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / grafito / exponencial"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel

button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

name: Panel glass oceano · cuadrado · circular · radio 20
description: Variante configurable de la receta de panel RCC: distribución cuadrado de 320 × 320, paleta oceano RGB(20, 65, 77), transición Circular de 0.35s y esquinas de 20px. Crea una interfaz adaptable y un botón que alterna la transparencia; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Panel glass oceano · cuadrado · circular · radio 20
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propio juego.
-- Variante configurable: misma receta de interfaz; cambia tamaño, color y transición.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 65, 77)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 320, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 320) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / oceano / circular"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Circular, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

name: Panel glass pizarra · cuadrado · circular · radio 8
description: Variante configurable de la receta de panel RCC: distribución cuadrado de 320 × 320, paleta pizarra RGB(50, 62, 78), transición Circular de 0.35s y esquinas de 8px. Crea una interfaz adaptable y un botón que alterna la transparencia; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Panel glass pizarra · cuadrado · circular · radio 8
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propio juego.
-- Variante configurable: misma receta de interfaz; cambia tamaño, color y transición.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 62, 78)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 320, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 320) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / pizarra / circular"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Circular, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

name: AutoTouch: Esperar un color con límite
description: Espera hasta diez segundos a que el centro coincida con el color configurado, con tolerancia RGB.
code:
-- RCC | AutoTouch: Esperar un color con límite
-- Guarda como .lua y ejecuta desde AutoTouch.

local w, h = getScreenResolution()
local target, tolerance = 0xFFFFFF, 12 -- Ajusta el color esperado.
local function channel(color, shift) return math.floor(color / 2^shift) % 256 end
for attempt = 1, 40 do
  local color, matches = getColor(math.floor(w/2), math.floor(h/2)), true
  for _, shift in ipairs({16, 8, 0}) do
    if math.abs(channel(color, shift)-channel(target, shift)) > tolerance then matches = false end
  end
  if matches then toast('Color detectado'); return end
  usleep(250000)
end
toast('Tiempo de espera agotado')

name: AutoTouch: Detectar cambio de pantalla
description: Compara el píxel central durante cinco segundos y avisa cuando cambia.
code:
-- RCC | AutoTouch: Detectar cambio de pantalla
-- Guarda como .lua y ejecuta desde AutoTouch.

local w, h = getScreenResolution()
local x, y = math.floor(w/2), math.floor(h/2)
local initial = getColor(x, y)
for attempt = 1, 20 do
  usleep(250000)
  if getColor(x, y) ~= initial then toast('Cambio detectado en el centro'); return end
end
toast('El píxel central no cambió')

name: AutoTouch: Muestrear una cuadrícula de colores
description: Lee nueve puntos de la pantalla y muestra sus colores sin ejecutar toques.
code:
-- RCC | AutoTouch: Muestrear una cuadrícula de colores
-- Guarda como .lua y ejecuta desde AutoTouch.

local w, h = getScreenResolution()
local lines = {}
for row = 1, 3 do
  for col = 1, 3 do
    local x, y = math.floor(w*col/4), math.floor(h*row/4)
    lines[#lines+1] = ('(%d, %d): #%06X'):format(x, y, getColor(x, y))
  end
end
alert(table.concat(lines, '\n'))

name: AutoTouch: Dibujar un círculo táctil
description: Traza un círculo en el centro; abre antes una app de dibujo.
code:
-- RCC | AutoTouch: Dibujar un círculo táctil
-- Guarda como .lua y ejecuta desde AutoTouch.

local w, h = getScreenResolution()
local cx, cy, radius = math.floor(w/2), math.floor(h/2), math.floor(math.min(w,h)*0.2)
usleep(3000000)
touchDown(0, cx+radius, cy)
for step = 1, 60 do
  local angle = step*2*math.pi/60
  touchMove(0, math.floor(cx+radius*math.cos(angle)), math.floor(cy+radius*math.sin(angle)))
  usleep(16000)
end
touchUp(0, cx+radius, cy)

name: AutoTouch: Toque condicionado por color
description: Toca el centro solo si su color coincide con el color configurado; evita tocar en caso contrario.
code:
-- RCC | AutoTouch: Toque condicionado por color
-- Guarda como .lua y ejecuta desde AutoTouch.

local expected = 0xFFFFFF -- Sustituye por el color del control de destino.
local w, h = getScreenResolution()
local x, y = math.floor(w/2), math.floor(h/2)
usleep(2000000)
if getColor(x, y) ~= expected then toast('Color distinto: no se ejecuta el toque'); return end
touchDown(0, x, y); usleep(50000); touchUp(0, x, y)
toast('Toque ejecutado')
